title: The Vanished Script Pages
intro: Tomorrow's surprise plot twin of the community theater's spring musical has gone missing from the prop room, and someone has been whispering the ending around town.

suspects.name: Rafi
suspects.line: I fixed the lights and then I went home. That is my whole night.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was in the wings all evening, humming my solo. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: Paint night at the back door. I never touch paperwork, I promise.

suspects.name: Juniper
suspects.line: I was rehearsing my dance in the hall. Alone, sadly, with no witnesses.

suspects.name: Bea
suspects.line: I sell tickets, dear. I have not stepped near the prop room in a week.

clues.text: A dropped item confirms the culprit wore a red scarf that evening, a bright thread caught on the hook as they hurried out.
A sign-in sheet shows the culprit was NOT last seen near the stage lights, since they were signed out of the booth well before the pages vanished.
A smudged note on the mirror says the culprit was NOT wearing round glasses; the only lenses left behind are square and belong to someone else.
Clean fingerprints on the script pages show the culprit's hands were NOT stained with paint, so they never touched the wet scenery.
